title: Not All Play is Equal: In-game Player Behaviour Predicts Wellbeing Differences (analysis code and manuscript source)
description:
Analysis code and Quarto manuscript source for the article Not All Play is Equal: In-game Player Behaviour Predicts Wellbeing Differences (ACM Games: Research and Practice). The repository contains the data-cleaning pipeline (preprocessing_new.qmd), the full analysis and manuscript (manuscript.qmd), shared helper functions (helpers.R), the bibliography, and a rendered HTML version of the manuscript (text, tables, and figures).

The raw survey and telemetry data from Plants vs. Zombies: Battle for Neighborville are not included. They were released by Johannes, Vuorre, and Przybylski (2021) and are available at https://osf.io/cjd6z/. See the README for reproduction steps.
